description: Add a Claude Code hook (UserPromptSubmit, and SessionStart on resume) that warns you when a session's context passes a threshold (default 200000), then again every further 100k, with the per-message plan cost when calibrated, plus a PostToolUse hook that warns when one tool result adds a lot of context. Leaves other hooks untouched; backs up settings.json. Dry run by default.

toolThreshold.description: Tokens one tool result must add before PostToolUse warns (default 10000)

name: install_hooks
